definitions.explanation: Describes someone who behaves in an overly bold or presumptuous manner without feeling embarrassed, often imposing on others or acting without regard for social conventions. Generally carries a negative connotation.

examples.japanese: {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}→申し訳：03810_moushiwake⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧...
examples.english: I'm sorry for the shameless request, but...
examples.notes: Humble phrasing when making a request

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{図々|ずうずう}しく⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{割|わ}り{込|こ}んで→割り込む：06973_warikomu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: That person brazenly cut in line.

examples.japanese: {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あきれた→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧。
examples.english: I was appalled by their shameless attitude.

notes:
FORMS:
- {図々|ずうずう}しい (plain form)
- {図々|ずうずう}しく (adverbial form)
- {図々|ずうずう}しさ (noun form - shamelessness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ (presumptuous, pushy)
- ⟦ふてぶてしい→ふてぶてしい：06709_futebuteshii⟧ (brazen, shameless)
- ⟦{恥知|はじし}らず→恥知らず：21065_hajishirazu⟧ (shameless person)
- ⟦{面|つら}→面：02231_tsura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick-skinned)

USAGE:
- Strongly negative when describing others
- Can be used self-deprecatingly to acknowledge one's own bold request
- Different from confidence - implies disregard for others

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Japanese culture values ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧ (reserve/restraint)
- Being {図々|ずうずう}しい violates expectations of modesty
- Used to criticize people who don't follow social norms

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {図々|ずうずう}しく⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (impudently, brazenly)
- {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (There's a limit to shamelessness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧ (shameless request)
- {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (impudent attitude)
- {図々|ずうずう}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (shameless person)
